_comment: Peacock pack switches read by kubejs/server_scripts/*.js. Server-side; takes effect on /reload or restart. ladder=false disables recipe staging and place/hire gates (Blueprints still drop). sleepPercent: players (%) that must sleep to skip the night (-1 = vanilla rule untouched). afkMinutes: minutes without moving before a name greys out in the tab list (0 = off). capitalWall: build the stone wall around the capital on first load (/peacock wall reruns it). capitalFound: if the world has no capital at spawn, survey gentle land near the origin and found one there (/peacock found reruns it; `here` founds at your feet).
